title: Migrate Database to Modern SQL Server
problem_statement: The application uses an outdated Microsoft Jet OLEDB provider for database access.
risk_if_unaddressed: Continued use of an unsupported database provider increases security risks and limits scalability.
suggested_approach: Migrate the database to a modern SQL Server and update connection strings.
success_criteria: Database is accessible via a modern, supported provider.
All application functionality remains intact post-migration.
